about.description: Aurus provides tokenized access to physical commodities and precious metals through blockchain infrastructure. It enables fractional ownership and efficient settlement of commodity positions.
about.registryInfo: Aurus Technologies Ltd. (UK, FCA-registered) — gold/silver/platinum tokenization platform launched 2018. Issues AWG (gold), AWS (silver), AWP (platinum) tokens with 1:1 physical-bullion backing held in LBMA-approved vaults. ARO governance/utility token.

fees.revenueNotes: Aurus (tGOLD, tSILVER, tPLATINUM) charges zero recurring storage or management fees to token holders. Aurus revenue comes from minting fees paid by bullion-provider partners (refineries, vaults, traders) within the Aurus Ecosystem at the moment of token issuance, not from holders. Tokens are 1:1 backed by LBMA-accredited physical bullion. Source: https://aurus.org/tgold
